text:
[IRET.7.9.4] **Block count tracking.** A token's block count at a NOT node
is the number of right facts its left-token join index records as blocking
that token, keyed by token identity ([IRET.7.3]). There is no separate count
structure, so the count and the blockers cannot disagree. Right-activation and
right-retraction update the index. A token with no recorded blocker holds no
entry.

idris.name: iret_7_9_4__count
idris.note: The block count of a token, keyed by token identity, as the clause states: zero when no entry is held.

idris.name: iret_7_9_4__set_count
idris.note: Set a token's count; a zero count holds no entry.

idris.name: Iret_7_7__consistent
idris.note: A NOT node's counts are its blockers, in the consistency relation.

idris.name: Iret_7_9_4__counts_ok
idris.note: A NOT node's counts are its blockers, over the tokens named.

idris.name: iret_7_9_4__count_filter_keep
idris.note: Dropping entries of departed tokens leaves the others' counts.

idris.name: iret_7_9_4__count_filter_other
idris.note: Dropping another token's entry leaves the count.

idris.name: iret_7_9_4__count_filter_zero
idris.note: Dropping a token's entry zeroes its count.

idris.name: iret_7_9_4__count_set_eq
idris.note: Setting a token's count sets it.

idris.name: iret_7_9_4__count_set_neq
idris.note: Setting another token's count leaves it.
